adversarial_expectations: Omitting any physical row/cell or table in these four statement tables is a key mismatch, including a printed nil/dash, zero, comparative column, or continued label fragment.
A reused inline fact ID must remain bound to this file source_id+SHA-256+table/row/cell and its own contextRef/unitRef; cross-filing substitution is invalid.
Wrong period/date/context, entity/dimension member, unitRef, scale, sign, lexeme or source quote is invalid. XBRL decimals is retained as precision metadata and must not be treated as unit scale.
A printed dash/nil is preserved separately from numeric fact value 0; a nil/absent fact is never silently filled from a different filing vintage.
Balance-sheet carrying values remain the reported balance-sheet facts; they do not by themselves establish debt principal/commitment or a normalized debt basis.
No derived quarterly/year/TTM cells are admitted here: do not difference, annualize, roll LTM, or reinterpret source filing vintages.
open_questions: Any exact visible numeric cell not represented by an inline XBRL fact remains recoverable only as printed cell text here; an adopted mapping to a financial fact requires review rather than an invented tag/context.
Any XBRL context/unit reference missing from these primary files, malformed dimension, or label continuation that cannot be mapped to a finite row identity stays AUTHORING_BLOCKED.
This key does not choose CP-1 output row identity, selected Model period scope, or methods; these require separate adopted authority.
The full 12-band Model, report, chart data and non-face disclosure universe remain separate authoring scopes.
